images.scene: A business owner seen waist-up, LARGE in the frame, sitting at his desk late at night buried behind towering stacks of paper reports, lit only by the harsh pool of a desk lamp, deep shadows carving his tired face as he stares down at the papers, unaware of the vast dark workshop dissolving into gloom behind his back. Dramatic chiaroscuro; the figure fills the bottom half of the frame; the upper half is bright, pale, hazy and empty, fading to near-white at the top edge.

Seen from across the busy factory work floor: a businessman in a suit walking away from the camera toward a private office door at the far end of the hall, workers at their benches in the foreground going on with their work, his back turned to them. The workers and the floor fill the bottom third; the upper half is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

An empty office desk with an old rotary telephone and a closed ledger, hard thin stripes of light and shadow from closed venetian blinds falling across the desk surface and the empty chair behind it. The desk sits low in the frame; the upper half is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

A tall pile of yellowed paper reports and dusty ring binders stacked on a wooden office desk, a faded wall calendar hanging slightly crooked behind the pile, specks of dust floating in the light. The stack sits low in the frame; the upper half is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

A dark puddle of water spreading on the concrete floor in the corner of a warehouse, one falling drop caught mid-air above it, stacked cardboard boxes and wooden crates around the puddle with water stains creeping up their bases. The puddle and crates sit low in the frame; the upper half is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

A businessman in a suit seen from behind, briefcase in hand, walking down a steep iron staircase back toward the busy factory work floor spread out below him. The staircase and figure sit low in the frame; the upper half is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

A shopkeeper's hands pressing the round keys of an antique brass cash register on a worn wooden shop counter, a paper receipt curling out of the machine, no face visible. The register and hands sit low in the frame; the upper half is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

A shop owner in rolled-up sleeves leaning on his side of a wooden shop counter, listening closely to an older customer who talks gesturing with both hands, a young clerk standing beside the owner also listening. A closed office door with a frosted glass panel at the end of a narrow corridor, weak light glowing faintly through the frosted glass, dark wooden door frame and worn floor in front. The door sits low in the frame; the upper half is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

A businessman walking slowly through the central aisle of an old covered municipal market, stalls with wooden crates of produce and hanging scales on both sides, vendors working in the background, the man observing the movement around him. A man's hands writing with a fountain pen in an open ruled notebook on a workshop bench, a pocket watch and an enamel mug resting beside the notebook, no face visible. The hands and the bench sit low in the frame; the upper half is bright, pale, hazy and empty.
